exposure: basal plate myofibers (BPMF) in an index pregnancy
outcome: placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) in the subsequent pregnancy
cohort: Participants were women with at least two consecutive pregnancies who had placental histopathological studies at a single tertiary referral center between August 2012 and March 2020.
finding: A histopathological diagnosis of BPMF in an index pregnancy was identified as a significant independent risk factor for placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) in the subsequent pregnancy.
followup_time: until the delivery of the subsequent pregnancy
